name: kivo-rebuild
description: Rebuild an existing WordPress site on the Roots stack: connect search and measurement sources, survey the live site into a decided URL inventory, audit legacy features against the new project, review it on a shared board

interface.shortDescription: Survey a live WordPress site and audit parity before rebuilding it on the Roots stack.
interface.longDescription: Connects Search Console, GA4, Tag Manager and edge sources, crawls the live site into a URL inventory with proposed keep/redirect/gone/noindex decisions, groups URLs by template, inventories what the legacy code does and classifies each feature against the new project. Plans new-site GA4, Tag Manager and Search Console setup behind an approval gate. Requires the kivo-wise plugin.
